cloud_jobs_sleep_check_due_idx.name: cloud_jobs_sleep_check_due_idx
cloud_jobs_sleep_check_due_idx.where: "cloud_jobs"."status" IN ('running', 'idle') AND "cloud_jobs"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."sleep_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."sleep_requested_at" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."snapshot_requested_at" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."vendor" IN ('modal', 'daytona', 'e2b')

cloud_jobs_sleep_check_stale_worker_idx.name: cloud_jobs_sleep_check_stale_worker_idx
cloud_jobs_sleep_check_stale_worker_idx.where: "cloud_jobs"."status" IN ('running', 'idle') AND "cloud_jobs"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."worker_heartbeat_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."sleep_requested_at" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."snapshot_requested_at" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."vendor" IN ('modal', 'daytona', 'e2b')

cloud_jobs_sleep_check_active_idx.name: cloud_jobs_sleep_check_active_idx
cloud_jobs_sleep_check_active_idx.where: "cloud_jobs"."status" IN ('running', 'idle') AND "cloud_jobs"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."sleep_requested_at" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."snapshot_requested_at" IS NULL AND "cloud_jobs"."vendor" IN ('modal', 'daytona', 'e2b')

repositories_github_shape_check.name: repositories_github_shape_check
repositories_github_shape_check.value: "repositories"."source_control_provider" != 'github' OR ("repositories"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "repositories"."github_repo_id" IS NOT NULL)

webhooks_status_exclusive.name: webhooks_status_exclusive
webhooks_status_exclusive.value:
(
        (succeeded_at IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (failed_at IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (ignored_at IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) <= 1
